author: hdprajwal
abstract: Read/extract/fill/generate Office and PDF documents from Python: pdfplumber+pypdf (text/tables, merge/split, forms, OCR), python-docx (Word read/build), openpyxl/pandas (Excel). Library-over-shell, work-on-a-copy, verify-the-output. Adapted from the pdf/docx/xlsx skills in anthropics/skills.
